list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before the bounty opened (2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words; every guide is written for this entry.

sources.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (official names, descriptions, grades)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI (grades and PSN progress counts)

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then the character and stranger strands, then the open-world collectibles, and finally the mastery and mop-up trophies. The last trophy you need is usually 'A Long Road' (100% completion), so treat that as the finish line.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — PSN tracks the count to $250,000. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts turn them into clean cash; keep laundering what you earn rather than spending the bills raw. It is a money grind that builds alongside the robbery trophies, so work it through the story and the open-world heists. No contact or rate is named in the official description, so none is claimed here.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — PSN tracks the count to $100,000. Any shop spending counts: clothes, weapons, food, vehicles and upgrades. It builds naturally over a full playthrough, and if you are short at the end, buy and sell high-value items or stock up on ammo and upgrades to close the gap. There is no trick to it — just spend, and track the total in the game.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — PSN tracks the count to 8. Garages are bought with in-game money and give you somewhere to store vehicles; visit the property listings or the garage signs around Leonida and buy each one. Save up for them through the story and the money trophies, and buy them as you can afford them rather than all at once. No garage locations are claimed here, since the official description does not list them.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — PSN tracks the count to 10. Use the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone to register vehicles you own or find; each new registration counts once. It pairs with discovering 100 vehicles, so register the interesting ones as you find them rather than saving it for the end. No vehicle list is claimed here, since the official description does not give one.
